newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says it killed nine Kurd guerrillas.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says it killed nine Kurd guerrillas.

text.p: Security forces have killed nine Kurd guerrillas in recent clashes in eastern Turkey, the state-run Anatolian news agency said on Thursday.

It quoted a statement from the governer's office in Erzurum province as saying the rebels were killed in operations during the last four days along the border between the eastern provinces of Bingol and Erzurum. It gave no military casualties.
The governor's office was not available for immediate comment.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in the 12-year-old armed struggle between troops and Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebels, fighting for autonomy or independence from Ankara.
